$comment: The display policy: which records a page shows, and as what. It is this host's own rule, not signed and not verified. Every rule names its statuses, so a status no rule names is refused. The roles are the ones scripts/sign_records.py writes under each record's extensions.role. scripts/sign_records.py sets signer to the one did:key the served records carry; until the example's own records are signed, that is the host template's placeholder key.

display.$comment: An active analysis notebook, dashboard source or graph file: a source file signed at a pinned commit.
An active retrieval record: a snapshot of what a pinned URL served, or a manifest of it.
The host template's placeholder note, until the example's own records replace it.
A withdrawn record of any role stays listed, marked withdrawn.
